purpose: Validation-only descriptive features defined before new replication test access; no fitting or checkpoint changes

gradient_and_permutation.source: first256 saved validation target pairs in each training panel

paired_pulse.source: additional Gaussian validation probe; not the replication test
features: mean log-scale response to pulse for each context
mean signed pulse-induced context64-minus16 log-scale contrast
mean absolute pulse-induced context64-minus16 log-scale contrast

interpretation: The controlled pulse is a synthetic model-response probe. Event timing is used only to construct/score it and never enters the model. Gradients and old-block permutation are model-dependence diagnostics, not causal explanations or learned-memory guarantees. Feature-outcome associations remain exploratory and must retain all30 fits.
